policy: Project evidence is curated from page-level PDF text. It does not promote disclosure keyword signals; records missing company, technology, page, source_file, snippet, and project or measure name remain review-only.

records.project_name_en: Building Onsite Energy Generation
records.measure_name_en: Investing in onsite solutions such as solar panels, wind turbines, and energy storage systems
records.cost_or_investment_en: Report states many onsite solutions include cost advantages; no quantified cost is disclosed in this snippet.
records.snippet_en: Building Onsite Energy Generation: We are investing in onsite solutions such as solar panels, wind turbines, and energy storage systems to reduce dependency on external power sources. Many of these solutions include cost advantages as well. Between 2024 and the end of 2030, we aim to enable up to 10 gigawatts (GW) of new clean energy projects.

records.subtype_en: Heavy-duty battery EVs and electric yard trucks
records.project_name_en: Class 8 Heavy-Duty and Yard Truck Innovations
records.measure_name_en: Piloting electric semi-trucks and using electric yard trucks at some facilities
records.implementation_stage: piloting and in-use at some facilities
records.abatement_effect_en: Report states electric yard trucks demonstrated over a 75% emissions reduction per hour of operation compared to diesel-powered vehicles.
records.snippet_en: Class 8 Heavy-Duty and Yard Truck Innovations: We support the development of new technologies like renewable diesel, battery-electric, and hydrogen fuels through feasibility testing and collaboration with manufacturers. For example, we are piloting electric semi-trucks in our fleet and currently use electric yard trucks at some facilities, which have demonstrated over a 75% emissions reduction, per hour of operation, compared to diesel-powered vehicles.

records.subtype_en: Hydrogen fuel cell vehicles and forklifts
records.project_name_en: Operationalizing New Technologies
records.measure_name_en: Piloting heavy-duty battery EVs and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, including liquid hydrogen-operated forklifts
records.snippet_en: Operationalizing New Technologies: We are piloting innovative technologies, including heavy-duty battery EVs and hydrogen fuel cell vehicles, including transitioning to liquid hydrogen-operated forklifts and opening the first industrial-scale renewable hydrogen plant in Latin America which aims to power our hydrogen-powered forklifts in Chile.

records.subtype_en: Electric delivery vans and charging network
records.project_name_en: Electric delivery fleet expansion
records.measure_name_en: Deploying electric delivery vans globally and chargers at delivery stations
records.abatement_effect_en: Report describes the eActros 600 heavy goods vehicles joining Amazon's Europe network as zero-tailpipe-emission vehicles; no quantified CO2e avoided amount is disclosed in this snippet.
records.snippet_en: Expanding our electric delivery fleet by delivering 1.5 billion packages to customers using more than 31,400 electric delivery vans and other EVs. To support our expanding EV network, we installed 11,770 chargers at 50 delivery stations, creating the largest private charging network in the U.S. In early 2025, we also announced our largest order of zero-tailpipe-emission heavy goods vehicles, with more than 200 new Mercedes-Benz Trucks eActros 600 vehicles set to join our transportation network in Europe.

records.measure_name_en: Procured blended sustainable aviation fuel
records.snippet_en: Scaling lower-carbon fuels. In 2024, Amazon procured 3.7 million gallons of blended sustainable aviation fuel (SAF).

records.project_name_en: Design and materials roadmap
records.measure_name_en: Using recycled lithium, zinc, rare earth elements, and low-carbon materials in products
records.abatement_effect_en: Report attributes 6.2M avoided emissions to low-carbon materials in the Apple comprehensive carbon footprint graphic.

Our progress: More than doubled the use of certified recycled lithium and zinc shipped in our products in 2024. iPhone 16 uses more than 95 percent recycled lithium in the battery, a first for Apple.

records.subtype_en: Solar power plants with co-located battery storage
records.project_name_en: Danish Fields and Cottonwood solar power plants
records.measure_name_en: Commissioned solar power plants with co-located battery storage in southeast Texas
records.snippet_en: In 2024, TotalEnergies commissioned Danish Fields (720 MW) and Cottonwood (455 MW), two solar power plants with co-located battery storage in southeast Texas. These new projects are part of a portfolio of more than 8 GW of renewable assets in operation in the country.

records.subtype_en: Process gas treatment and process upgrade
records.project_name_en: DS Division process gas treatment expansion
records.measure_name_en: Expanded RCS process gas treatment facilities and high-efficiency RCS catalyst development
records.abatement_effect_en: Report places process gas treatment expansion in the DS Division GHG Emission Reduction Roadmap and states the roadmap aims to achieve net zero Scope 1 and 2 emissions for the DS Division.
records.snippet_en: GHG Emission Reduction Roadmap: operate bimonthly Net Zero Committee and Carbon Reduction Committee to establish and execute DS Division GHG reduction action items; expand process gas treatment facility (RCS) installation; reduce LNG boiler usage through expansion of waste heat recovery; develop/apply high efficiency RCS catalyst; expand the utilization of waste heat recovery system; develop innovative technologies for improving process gas treatment efficiency; improve energy efficiency of FAB facilities through cooperation with facility companies; achieve net zero Scope 1, 2 emissions for DS Division.

records.project_name_en: LNG use reduction and waste heat recovery

records.abatement_effect_en: Report identifies reduced LNG boiler usage through waste heat recovery as part of Samsung Electronics' DS Division GHG Emission Reduction Roadmap to achieve net zero Scope 1 and 2 emissions.
records.snippet_en: To reduce the use of LNG boilers, Samsung Electronics will expand the utilization of waste heat and consider introducing electric heat sources. The roadmap includes reducing LNG boiler usage through expansion of waste heat recovery and expanding the utilization of the waste heat recovery system.

records.project_name_en: Korea DS Division solar PPA
records.measure_name_en: PPA with SK E&S and Samsung C&T for renewable energy from a 60 MW solar power plant
records.snippet_en: The DS Division signed a PPA with SK E&S in Nov. 2023 and with Samsung C&T in Mar. 2024 to supply approximately 76.2 GWh of renewable energy annually from a 60 MW solar power plant for 20 years for a total of 1,466 GWh of renewable energy, starting in 2025. So far, Samsung has installed a total of 2.8 MW of solar power generation facilities and generated 2.8 GWh of energy in 2023 for on-site use.

records.project_name_en: Spain and United States solar VPPAs
records.measure_name_en: VPPAs covering solar projects expected to generate RECs for North America and EU purchased electricity
records.snippet_en: Pfizer invests in no- and low-carbon technologies at its sites and through VPPAs that enable sourcing of renewable energy. VPPAs covering solar projects in Spain and the United States, coming online in 2025, are expected to generate RECs to cover approximately 100% of Pfizer's purchased electricity needs in North America and the EU.

records.project_name_en: Cleaner Fuel SAF scale-up
records.measure_name_en: SAF deliveries, long-term offtake agreements, Minnesota SAF Hub collaboration, and MSP blending facility launch
records.abatement_effect_en: Report states 13M+ gallons of SAF uplifted in 2024 and 119,781 metric tons CO2e avoided.
records.snippet_en: Cleaner Fuel: Delta signed millions of gallons in long-term offtake agreements with existing and emerging SAF producers. In 2024, Delta more than tripled SAF deliveries compared to 2023, for a total of over 13 million gallons. Delta also collaborated through the Minnesota SAF Hub to produce the first-ever batch of Minnesota crop-based SAF and announced the launching of a SAF blending facility to serve MSP airport. The page states 13M+ gallons of SAF uplifted in 2024 and 119,781 metric tons CO2e avoided.

records.project_name_en: Ngarluma Country 80 MW solar farm
records.measure_name_en: Development of an 80 MW solar farm near Karratha to supply renewable energy to Pilbara operations
records.abatement_effect_en: Report states the project has potential to reduce natural gas used for generation across Pilbara operations by up to 11% and could reduce emissions by up to 120 kt CO2e when complete.
records.snippet_en: Together with the Ngarluma Aboriginal Corporation, Rio Tinto is progressing the development of an 80 MW solar farm on Ngarluma Country, near Karratha, to supply renewable energy to Pilbara operations. When complete, this project has the potential to reduce the amount of natural gas currently used for generation across Pilbara operations by up to 11%, and could reduce Rio Tinto's emissions by up to 120 kt CO2e.

records.snippet_en: Other renewable electricity developments: commenced construction of solar PV at Gove (10 MW) and Amrun mine (12 MW); executed wind Virtual Power Purchase Agreement (VPPA) (78.5 MW) at Monte Cristo in the US to abate regional Scope 2 emissions; completed construction and commenced operating Diavik diamond mine solar plant (3 MW); commissioned a 5 MW solar plant and commenced construction of Kennecott solar Phase 2 (25 MW); signed a 230 MW wind PPA at Overberg for Richards Bay Minerals and a 140 MW wind PPA at Khangela.

records.implementation_stage: in development and collaboration; not yet complete
records.snippet_en: Rio Tinto is exploring a renewable energy project with the Yindjibarndi Energy Corporation. Currently in development by YEC, the project includes 75 MW of solar on a greenfield site west of Millstream Chichester National Park on Yindjibarndi Country. It is the first project the parties are exploring together since signing an MOU to collaborate on potential renewable energy opportunities, including wind and solar power and battery energy storage systems.

The facility is designed to generate approximately 60,000 MWh/year of electricity, reduce the complex's grid power demand by 50%, and is expected to avoid approximately 33,000 metric tons of carbon dioxide emissions a year. The facility became fully operational in 2025.
